speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a concerning rash and recent health changes; to begin our assessment, how long have you had these symptoms, and can you describe the rash's appearance and location?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DRESS) or serum sickness-like reaction secondary to new arthritis medication.

I need to know the specific name of the new arthritis medication you started and exactly when you began taking it, as well as any other new medications or supplements you are using. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Liver_Function_Tests, Eosinophil_Count, Urinalysis.
